values: OWR-14297740-021 (30005649): Self-duality of quasi-supersingular group schemes

A counterexample to Takao's self-duality question — Alec Kriebel (ORCID0009-0001-9320-500X), v1.0. Preprint date: 2026-10-04. Gives an explicit negative answer to Takao's higher-rank question after Proposition2, printed2479 of OWR42/2023. For every prime p>3 and n>=3 over k=an algebraic closure of F_p, constructs a p-killed finite flat commutative W(k)-group of rank p^(2n), with quasi-supersingular special fiber, such that both the special fiber and its Witt-ring lift fail Cartier self-duality. Quasi-supersingularity uses actual supersingular elliptic p-torsion factors over k. The proof gives an explicit six-dimensional Dieudonne module, elliptic filtration, image-intersection invariant and finite Honda complement; standard factors cover every n>=3. No quasi-supersingular Witt-ring filtration or descent to every perfect field is asserted. Established cyclic-word, supersingular, Dieudonne and finite Honda theory is credited. In-depth bounded primary-literature audit; source/access/version limitations retained. No first-discovery, first-application or worldwide continuing-openness certificate. Four-page unrefereed research note; extensive AI use, no independent external human peer review. Three independent mathematical approach families and three successive NEW full preprint adversaries. Historical review01 B1 and review02 F01/root B2 remain adverse as dated records; both supporting-software defects were repaired globally in the public derivative. The third NEW full review of the repaired v04 packet has zero unresolved mandatory findings. PDF plus33-member verification ZIP,32 payloads. Python3.12 and3.14 full outputs compared byte for byte. Dense nonprime basis changes and opposite squared-Frobenius kernel twists verified; targeted negative controls rejected. Characteristic-two tests cover generic semilinear algebra only, not an extension of the p>3 theorem. All15 original problem files preserved; original author progress remains1/5. Primary question: https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/47479?nt=1, printed2479/PDF103; report DOI10.4171/OWR/2023/42. Record: https://zenodo.org/records/23133607. Reviewed PR: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/344.

records.title: A counterexample to Takao's self-duality question
records.description:
For every prime p greater than 3 and every n at least 3, this research note constructs a finite flat commutative group scheme over W(closure of F_p), killed by p and of rank p^(2n), with quasi-supersingular special fiber, such that both the special fiber and its Witt-ring lift fail Cartier self-duality. It gives an explicit negative answer to the higher-rank question following Proposition 2 on page 2479 of Naotake Takao's contribution to Oberwolfach Report 42/2023.

The proof uses an explicit six-dimensional Dieudonne module, a supersingular elliptic p-torsion filtration, an image-intersection invariant and a finite Honda complement. These are applications of established Dieudonne and finite Honda theory, with the classical cyclic-word framework credited. No first-discovery or first-priority claim is made. The verification supplement includes portable standard-library controls, source references, the bounded priority audit and its access/version limitations.

This is an unrefereed preprint. AI tools were used extensively in solving, verification, literature research, writing, computation and adversarial review. Those automated reviews are not independent external human peer review; no such human review is claimed.
